column4: Guards cleat#4465: an answer written over a pending row stores the answer's own time in created_at, so a replay's Now() is the one the live run read. It drives the five Postgres statements that answer over a pending row directly, so it calls testutil.TestDB(t, DialectPostgres) with no dialect arms and skips whole, under its bare name, in a job that sets no PostgreSQL DSN. Measured by name on 2026-11-24 with only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL alone: go test ./engine/ -run '^TestEveryPostgresAnswerOverWriterStoresTheAnswersClock$' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly this test.
